name: Natural Mini Twists with Side Sweep
ai_description:
### Title: Natural Mini Twists with Side Sweep

### Overview
A head of small two-strand mini twists done on natural hair, worn with the front section swept across to one side so the twists fall diagonally over the brow line and gather at the ear. The twists reach jaw-to-neck length and hang with soft, relaxed movement. The look is entirely natural in colour — deep black with the kinky base texture showing through each twist — and a few tiny silver cuffs accent individual twists.

### Styling Details
- Small two-strand twists, roughly pencil-thin, on natural coily hair
- Jaw-to-neck length with slightly open, softly frizzed natural ends
- Front section swept to one side, creating a diagonal fall over the brow
- Visible clean scalp partings along the swept front rows
- Natural deep black colour with no extension hair
- A few small silver cuff accents scattered through the twists
- Medium, touchable volume with the 4B/4C base texture readable in each twist

### Ideal For
Oval, round, and heart face shapes. A low-tension everyday protective style that keeps natural hair moisturised and tucked in while staying soft and feminine. Refresh the sweep with a light mousse and re-twist the hairline rows every couple of weeks.

name: Silver Senegalese Twists with Cuffs
ai_description:
### Title: Silver Senegalese Twists with Cuffs

### Overview
Long Senegalese rope twists installed in a striking silver-grey, falling from a deep side part to waist-and-beyond length. The two-strand rope pattern is tight, smooth, and glossy along every twist, with darker natural roots blending into the pale silver lengths. Scattered metal cuff beads catch the light along the twists, and the ends finish in loose, tasselled tips.

### Styling Details
- Senegalese rope twists, roughly pencil-width, with a crisp two-strand spiral pattern
- Silver-grey extension hair blended from darker natural roots
- Waist-to-hip length with loose tasselled ends
- Deep side part with the heavier section swept across the crown
- Face-framing twists falling on both sides
- Several silver cuff beads placed irregularly along the lengths
- Smooth, low-frizz finish with a soft sheen

### Ideal For
Oval, round, and heart face shapes. The long vertical lines lengthen the profile while the silver colour makes a high-fashion statement without permanent dye. A full protective install that lasts 6–8 weeks; wrap at night and oil the scalp along the partings to keep it fresh.

name: Copper Spring Twists Bob
ai_description:
### Title: Copper Spring Twists Bob

### Overview
A jaw-length bob of springy kinky twists in a rich copper-rust colour. Each twist has the tight, crimped spring-twist texture that coils back on itself at the ends, giving the bob a full, bouncy silhouette. The style is parted to one side so the front twists fall across the forehead and graze one eye, and a single gold cuff accents a twist near the face.

### Styling Details
- Kinky spring twists with a tight, crimped corkscrew texture
- Uniform jaw-length bob shape with curled-under ends
- Rich copper-rust colour throughout the lengths
- Side part with the front twists sweeping across the forehead
- Dense, full coverage with rounded volume all around
- One gold cuff accent on a face-framing twist
- Soft matte finish typical of kanekalon spring hair

### Ideal For
Oval, square, and heart face shapes. A short protective install with major personality — the copper tone flatters warm and deep skin tones and the bob length keeps it light and easy to wear. Lasts 4–6 weeks; fluff the twists gently and re-lay the side sweep with foam.

name: Short Box Braids with Skin Fade
ai_description:
### Title: Short Box Braids with Skin Fade

### Overview
Short box braids on top paired with a clean high skin fade. The top is sectioned into a neat square grid and braided into slim plaits that fall forward and to the sides at brow-to-jaw length, each one finished with a small light-coloured tie at the end. The sides and back fade smoothly down to skin, keeping the whole look sharp and low-profile.

### Styling Details
- Slim box braids on the top section only, in a clean square parting grid
- Braids fall forward and outward at brow-to-jaw length
- Each braid end secured with a small light elastic tie
- High skin fade on the sides and back, blended tight into the braided top
- Natural black colour with no extensions — braided from the natural hair
- Fresh, low-frizz braid surface with defined plait pattern
- Balanced, rounded fall with no hard part

### Ideal For
Oval, square, and oblong face shapes. A sharp protective option for men growing out their top while keeping the sides tight. The fade needs a touch-up every 2–3 weeks; the braids can be redone monthly as the roots grow out.

name: Boho Fulani Braids with Amber Beads
ai_description:
### Title: Boho Fulani Braids with Amber Beads

### Overview
A Fulani-inspired boho braid set: neat feed-in cornrows pattern the front and crown, flowing into long individual braids mixed with loose bohemian curly strands that cascade to the waist. Two slim braids frame the face and are finished at chest level with chunky amber-gold bead wraps, the signature Fulani accent. The deep black braids and soft open curls give the style both structure and movement.

### Styling Details
- Feed-in cornrows across the front and crown in a Fulani-style pattern
- Long box-braid lengths blended with loose 3B boho curl strands to the waist
- Two face-framing front braids finished with chunky amber-gold bead wraps
- Deep natural black throughout
- Clean, even partings with smooth, laid edges at the hairline
- Curls interspersed through the braid body for a soft, full silhouette
- Chest-to-waist length with free-flowing movement

### Ideal For
Oval, round, and diamond face shapes. A heritage style with a modern boho finish — structured at the crown, romantic through the lengths. Lasts 4–6 weeks; sleep in a satin wrap and refresh the loose curls with mousse to keep them defined.

name: Threaded Crown Spikes with Low Bun
ai_description:
### Title: Threaded Crown Spikes with Low Bun

### Overview
A sculptural African threading style: sections of hair are wrapped smooth with thread from root to tip and shaped into bold spikes that rise and arc off the crown, while the remaining hair is gathered into a small wrapped bun at the back. Geometric partings divide the scalp cleanly between the wrapped sections. The finish is a deep black with a subtle plum sheen on the smooth thread-wrapped surfaces.

### Styling Details
- Traditional African threading — hair wrapped tightly with thread into smooth, firm lengths
- Four to five sculptural spikes rising from the crown, some arcing back toward the nape
- Clean geometric partings between the wrapped sections
- Remaining hair gathered into a compact wrapped bun at the back
- Deep black colour with a subtle plum sheen
- Neat hairline with controlled root tension
- Architectural, ceremonial silhouette with strong height

### Ideal For
Oval, heart, and diamond face shapes. A statement heritage style rooted in West African threading traditions — worn for occasions where the hair itself is the crown. Requires professional sectioning and wrapping; protect the shape at night with a loose bonnet and avoid moisture on the threaded lengths.

name: Sleek Relaxed Lob with Center Part
ai_description:
### Title: Sleek Relaxed Lob with Center Part

### Overview
A polished shoulder-grazing lob on relaxed hair, parted cleanly down the centre. The hair lies smooth and flat from the crown, falling in two even panels that frame the face and finish in blunt ends with a soft inward bevel right at the collarbone. The colour is a deep natural black-brown with a healthy mirror-like shine along the lengths.

### Styling Details
- Shoulder-grazing lob length, ending at the collarbone
- Clean centre part with a smooth, flat crown
- Relaxed, bone-sleek texture with no visible layering
- Blunt hemline with a soft inward bevel at the ends
- Deep natural black-brown colour
- High-gloss, frizz-free finish from a wrap-and-silken routine
- Even face-framing fall on both sides

### Ideal For
Oval, heart, and oblong face shapes. A clean, professional everyday shape for relaxed hair — long enough to tuck, short enough to swing. Maintain with regular wraps at night, a light serum for shine, and touch-ups every 8–10 weeks.

name: Half-Up High Pony with Loose Curls
ai_description:
### Title: Half-Up High Pony with Loose Curls

### Overview
A half-up, half-down install: the top section is smoothed back into a sleek high ponytail with the crown brushed glossy and flat, while the lower half hangs free in long, loose barrel curls that fall past the chest. The pony's own lengths curl and blend into the down section, so the whole style reads as one soft cascade of deep espresso-black waves under a polished crown.

### Styling Details
- Half-up construction — top section gathered into a sleek high ponytail
- Crown and sides smoothed flat with a glossy, laid finish
- Lower half worn down in loose barrel curls and body waves
- Chest-to-underbust length through the down section
- Deep espresso black-brown colour throughout
- Pony lengths curled to blend seamlessly into the loose hair
- Soft face-framing wave falling at each temple

### Ideal For
Oval, round, and square face shapes. The lifted crown adds height while the loose curls keep it romantic — a go-to install for events and everyday glam alike. Wrap the crown edges at night and refresh the curls with a wand every few days.

name: Honey-Lit Curly Bob
ai_description:
### Title: Honey-Lit Curly Bob

### Overview
A springy curly bob of defined 3A ringlets cut to chin-and-jaw length. The curls are warm brown at the base and lit through the front and ends with honey-blonde pieces, giving the whole shape a sun-kissed dimension. There is no hard part — the ringlets fall freely from the crown in a rounded, airy silhouette, with playful spirals dropping across the forehead and cheekbones.

### Styling Details
- Chin-to-jaw length bob cut for curl spring
- Defined 3A ringlets with visible spiral separation
- Warm brown base with honey-blonde highlights at the front and ends
- No set part — curls fall naturally from the crown
- Rounded, airy volume with face-framing spirals
- Light-hold curl cream finish, soft to the touch with minimal frizz
- Slightly undone, lived-in texture

### Ideal For
Oval, square, and heart face shapes. A cheerful, low-fuss shape for naturally curly hair — the bob length removes weight so the curls sit at their bounciest. Refresh with water and curl cream, scrunch, and air-dry; trim every 8–10 weeks to keep the shape.

name: Bronze-Tipped Short Locs with Fringe
ai_description:
### Title: Bronze-Tipped Short Locs with Fringe

### Overview
A short, shapely loc style worn with a rounded fringe of locs falling over the forehead. The locs are slim, even, and well-established, cut to ear-and-jaw length so they swing freely. The colour is the signature of the look: deep espresso roots melting into warm honey-bronze tips, so every loc ends in a lit point of colour.

### Styling Details
- Slim, evenly-sized mature locs, palm-rolled smooth
- Ear-to-jaw length with a full rounded loc fringe over the forehead
- Two-tone colour — deep espresso roots into honey-bronze tips
- Soft side-lean in the fall, with locs framing both cheeks
- Neat, clean partings and a well-maintained root grid
- Light natural sheen from oil-based loc care
- Compact, bouncy silhouette with real movement

### Ideal For
Oval, heart, and diamond face shapes. A short loc shape with built-in colour dimension — professional enough for every day, playful in the swing. Retwist every 4–6 weeks and refresh the bronze tips seasonally to keep the melt crisp.

name: Chunky Faux Locs with Thread Wraps
ai_description:
### Title: Chunky Faux Locs with Thread Wraps

### Overview
Thick, soft faux locs in matte jet black, worn to chest length from a deep side part so the heavier side sweeps across the forehead and cascades over one shoulder. The locs carry a fluffy, kinky surface texture rather than a smooth roll, and scattered locs are cross-wrapped with fine accent threads in red, yellow, green, and blue — small pops of colour woven along the black.

### Styling Details
- Chunky faux locs, finger-width, with a soft kinky surface texture
- Chest length with full, weighty movement
- Matte jet black base colour
- Deep side part with a heavy sweep across the forehead
- Fine multicolour accent threads cross-wrapped on scattered locs
- Laid, defined edges along the hairline
- Dense, full-coverage install with rounded crown volume

### Ideal For
Oval, round, and square face shapes. A bold protective install that delivers the loc look without the commitment — the thread wraps make it festival-ready while the black base keeps it wearable daily. Lasts 6–8 weeks; sleep in a satin bonnet and oil the scalp between the partings.

name: Loc Top Knot with Cowrie Shells
ai_description:
### Title: Loc Top Knot with Cowrie Shells

### Overview
Mature mid-length locs gathered high on the crown into a spiky top knot, the loose ends fanning up and outward in every direction for a bold, sculptural burst. The sides are swept cleanly up into the tie with no fade or cut, and a band of white cowrie shells wraps the base of the knot as the style's signature accent. The locs are jet black with a healthy, pebbled surface texture.

### Styling Details
- Mature, pencil-width locs with a well-kept pebbled texture
- All hair gathered into a high top knot at the crown
- Loc ends splaying upward and outward in a spiky fan
- Sides and back swept up into the tie — no fade, full-length locs throughout
- Jet black natural colour
- Cowrie shells banded around the base of the knot
- Strong vertical silhouette with playful, expressive height

### Ideal For
Oval, round, and square face shapes. A confident updo for established locs that keeps the neck clear and puts the crown on display — cultural, celebratory, and practical in one. Retwist the roots every 4–6 weeks and vary the knot height to rest the hairline.

name: Shoulder-Length 3C Ringlet Mane
ai_description:
### Title: Shoulder-Length 3C Ringlet Mane

### Overview
A dense, shoulder-length mane of tight 3C ringlets in jet black, worn full and rounded with no visible parting. Springy corkscrew curls tumble over the forehead in a curly fringe and fill out generously at the sides, framing the face completely. The curls are well-defined from root to end with a natural sheen, giving the whole head a rich, healthy density.

### Styling Details
- Tight 3C corkscrew ringlets with clear, springy definition
- Shoulder-length all around in a full, rounded silhouette
- Corkscrew fringe falling over the forehead
- No visible parting — curls fall freely from the crown
- Jet black colour with a natural, conditioned sheen
- Even density from crown to ends with face-framing volume at the sides
- Defined, clumped curl pattern with minimal frizz

### Ideal For
Oval, square, and oblong face shapes. A statement length for men with tight curls — the fullness softens angular features and the fringe brings the eyes forward. Maintain with leave-in conditioner and curl cream, detangle wet, and shape-trim every couple of months.

name: Even Short Natural Coils
ai_description:
### Title: Even Short Natural Coils

### Overview
A clean, even crop of natural 4B/4C coils worn at one to two inches all around, with no fade, no lineup, and no hard edges — just soft, uniform coil texture following the head's natural shape. The curl clumps are visible and springy across the top, and the hairline is left natural and soft. The colour is a rich jet black.

### Styling Details
- Natural 4B/4C coils at an even 1–2 inch length all around
- No fade, taper, or lineup — soft natural edges and hairline
- Visible sponge-coil curl clumps across the top and sides
- Rounded, compact silhouette hugging the head shape
- Rich jet black natural colour
- Light moisturised finish with a soft sheen
- Zero-manipulation shape grown from healthy natural texture

### Ideal For
Oval, oblong, and diamond face shapes. The most honest natural shape there is — no barbering tricks, just healthy coils kept even. Maintain with a weekly wash, daily moisture, and a sponge or pick for the coil definition; trim monthly to hold the length even.

name: Oversized Curly Afro Blowout
ai_description:
### Title: Oversized Curly Afro Blowout

### Overview
A huge, show-stopping curly afro blowout that extends well past the shoulders in every direction. The texture is a picked-out 3C/4A blend — airy and enormous in silhouette, but still holding visible corkscrew curl definition at the perimeter and through the fringe that drops over the brows. The colour is a deep near-black brown, and the sheer scale of the halo is the entire statement.

### Styling Details
- Oversized afro blowout extending past the shoulders on all sides
- 3C/4A texture, picked out at the roots for maximum airy volume
- Defined corkscrew curls at the perimeter and through the brow-grazing fringe
- Deep near-black brown colour
- No parting — one continuous halo silhouette from every angle
- Soft, blended crown with the density carried right to the ends
- Curl definition preserved through the blowout rather than brushed to frizz

### Ideal For
Oval, heart, and diamond face shapes. Maximum-volume natural glamour — the halo frames the face and owns every room. Achieved with a blow-dryer stretch and root pick on healthy natural hair; deep-condition weekly and pineapple at night to protect the volume.
